source.title: Two semi-open problems in queueing theory

trace.notes: Normalized https://zbmath.org/3819437 as a zbMATH resolver record. Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/3819437 returned HTTP 403 with Cloudflare challenge headers including cf-mitigated: challenge, so the resolver page was classified as blocked_or_challenged.

A local zbMATH-derived shard row identified the record as title "Two semi-open problems in queueing theory", year 1982, with no DOI, arXiv, or full-text links recorded. Attempts to query zbMATH REST/OAI endpoints from the local shell failed due DNS resolution failures in this environment, so no authoritative full-text link was recovered from those APIs.

Ran bounded exact-work recovery searches for the exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus Crossref/OpenAlex/DOI, and variants without the hyphen. Inspected the visible candidates returned by search, including ScienceDirect pages on queueing-theoretic dynamic scheduling and nested semi-open queuing networks, an MDPI 2024 article on queueing systems with correlated arrival processes, and a DOKUMEN book page. These were rejected because they were different works, snippets, or metadata/secondary sources and did not provide the full 1982 problem text for the same source.
